hero.title: Seventy-two hours
hero.lede: A hand-wound watch made by two watchmakers at one bench. It is running on your local time right now. Scroll to take it apart.
hero.firstText: 39 mm case, 11.2 mm thick. The seconds hand moves in eight steps every second.

stages.title: Tessel 39, assembled
stages.text: 39 mm case, 11.2 mm thick. The seconds hand moves in eight small steps every second.

stages.title: Sapphire crystal
stages.text: Domed sapphire, 2.1 mm, anti-reflective on the inside. It seals to 100 m with the polished bezel.

stages.title: Dial and blued hands
stages.text: The hands are heated to about 290 °C until the steel turns this blue. The dial sits on two feet.

stages.title: The going train
stages.text: Five wheels carry the spring's energy. Barrel to escape wheel is a ratio of 1 : 7,680.

stages.title: The escapement
stages.text: 28,800 beats an hour. The balance swings, the fork flicks, the escape wheel steps half a tooth.

stages.title: Back together
stages.text: 148 parts, 11.2 mm. Closed up and still keeping your time.

configure.title: Build yours.
configure.accent: The watch above changes with it.
configure.body: Pick a case metal, a dial and a strap. Each Tessel 39 is assembled and regulated to your order; we make 140 a year.

wind.title: Forty turns of the crown.
wind.body: The AD-28 has no rotor, so you wind it by hand. Drag the crown clockwise. Each turn adds 1.8 hours to the mainspring, and the reserve runs down in real time.

dual.title: Your time on the hands.
dual.accent: One more on the red arrow.
dual.body: The Tessel GMT adds a 24-hour hand that reads a second time zone against the outer ring. The shaded half of the ring is night. Pick a city to set it.

specs.title: Measured in millimetres,
specs.body: Watchmakers still size movements in lignes: one ligne is 2.2558 mm, an old French inch divided by twelve. Switch units to see the Tessel the way the bench sees it.

footer.fine: Aldane is a made-up business for a concept site.
